featured_reviews.name: Irremediable Soul
featured_reviews.review_text:
Delicious Treats Let Down by Poor Cleanliness

Theobroma in Malad offers a truly delightful selection of pastries, brownies, cakes and savouries. Whether you're in the mood for a gooey brownie, a flaky puff or a rich slice of cake, the assortment here never disappoints. The quality of the food is consistently excellent and the service is warm and prompt.

However, the experience was marred by a noticeable lack of cleanliness in the seating area. When I visited, I told the person at the counter that I would be dining in. Even then, I had to specifically request that they clean the table I wished to sit at. Out of just five tables in the café, three were left cluttered with partially eaten food and used trays. Bits of food were even on the floor.

Although the staff did respond once I pointed it out and proceeded to clean not just my table but the ones nearby as well, it was disappointing that it wasn’t taken care of proactively. Walking into a café and finding more than half the tables in such a state is not something one expects from a brand like Theobroma. It dampens the mood and detracts from the otherwise enjoyable experience.

Final thoughts:
Theobroma continues to impress with its food and friendly service but they must pay more attention to maintaining cleanliness in the café. First impressions count and a clean space is just as important as good food.

featured_reviews.name: Saahil Ledwani
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Theobroma, Malad West, and indulged in two of their classics – the Millionaire Brownies and the Chocolate Walnut Brownie. Both lived up to the hype and made the experience memorable.

The Millionaire Brownie was a true treat for the senses – rich layers of gooey caramel, smooth chocolate, and a crisp base that added the right crunch. Each bite had a perfect balance of sweetness and texture, making it indulgent without being overwhelmingly heavy. It’s the kind of dessert that makes you pause and savor every bite.

The Chocolate Walnut Brownie, on the other hand, was simple yet timeless. The deep chocolate flavor was beautifully complemented by the earthy crunch of walnuts. What I liked most was that it wasn’t overly sweet, which allowed the rich cocoa taste to shine through. It felt homely and comforting, yet elevated in quality – a perfect companion to a hot cup of coffee.

Theobroma has always been known for its consistency, and once again, they didn’t disappoint. The presentation was neat, the flavors were balanced, and the freshness was evident in every bite. For brownie lovers, these are definitely must-try options.

Overall, I’d rate this experience a solid 4.5/5. Theobroma manages to create desserts that strike the right balance between indulgence and quality.

Very Disappointed – Ruined a Special Occasion

I had ordered a Red Velvet cake for Father’s Day and specifically requested “Happy Father’s Day” to be written on it. Not only did the bakery send the wrong cake the first time, but even after contacting customer care and getting a replacement, they delivered the same wrong cake again. On top of that, both cakes had no message written, despite clear instructions.

Cakes are usually ordered for once-in-a-while special occasions, and these small details truly matter. It was very disappointing and made the celebration feel incomplete.

I returned the cake to the shop and asked for a refund, but was told to contact Swiggy customer care. Since then, I’ve been trying to reach them for over 2 hours. The first time, the executive asked me to hold while they checked the details — and then no one responded. I’ve been calling multiple times, but haven’t received proper help or resolution.

This kind of service is completely unacceptable — both from the bakery and from Swiggy’s support team. I hope this feedback is taken seriously, as people trust these platforms for important moments, and such negligence can ruin them.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Birdy’s Cake Shop, Orlem, Malad West, for a late-night sweet craving, and I must say it was quite an experience. The fact that the shop is open even around 11:30 pm is a huge plus point. It’s not very easy to find a cake shop open so late at night, so Birdy’s definitely scores well on accessibility and convenience.

I picked up two of their signature pastries – Death by Chocolate and Chocolate Overload Pastry. Both looked very tempting in the display, with rich layers of chocolate and a good finishing touch. Taste-wise, they were decent but not extraordinary. The Death by Chocolate had the classic layered feel, with sponge and chocolate mousse balancing each other, but it could have been richer and more indulgent. The Chocolate Overload Pastry lived up to its name visually, but flavor-wise it felt a bit repetitive, with the chocolate cream slightly overpowering rather than giving a balanced taste.

In terms of quality, Birdy’s still maintains a good standard – fresh, soft, and presentable pastries. But I’ve had better chocolate experiences at some of their other outlets in the past, so expectations were higher.

Overall, Birdy’s Orlem remains a reliable late-night option for cakes and pastries in Malad West. Service was quick, and the takeaway process was smooth. I’d rate my experience a solid 4/5 – good, but there’s room for improvement in taste consistency.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Bought a veggie burger, manchurian burger, black forest cake, pineapple cake, and a choco ball from here. Each of these items is in the INR 50-60 range.
The veggie burger was lackluster; can't say much about it. It had a wilted green which is a pathetic excuse for lettuce. For the price of INR 60, it's overpriced.
The manchurian burger was a huge let down. It was stale, had a weird flavor and smell. I suspect it was on the verge of going off. I threw it away. Also, this isn't the flavor of manchurian.
Both cakes were overly sweet with more icing than sponge. They had a synthetic taste as if over dosed with artificial flavoring. Monginis and Merwans do a much better job than this.
Choco balls were OK and I have nothing to complain about.
Service was below par; servers handled food without gloves. There is no experience to talk about.
I don't understand why this place is still around.

featured_reviews.name: Akash Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
I purchased cakes from Monjinis Cake Shop for both New Year and birthday celebrations, expecting fresh and good-quality cakes. Unfortunately, on both occasions, the cakes I received were not fresh at all. They tasted old, had an unpleasant smell, and the texture was dry, which clearly showed that they were not freshly prepared.
These were special moments meant to be enjoyed with family and friends, but the poor quality completely spoiled the experience. When customers buy cakes for important events, freshness and hygiene should be the top priority. Serving old cakes is unacceptable and raises serious concerns about food safety.
This experience has seriously broken my trust in this shop. I would not recommend this outlet to anyone.
Very disappointing.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Dear Akash Shah, We take pride in bringing smiles to millions of faces and strive to deliver excellent service. We are deeply sorry for the inconvenience caused. Your problem is our concern and utmost priority. Please write to us at customercare@monginis.net or call us on 02240786784, and we will be happy to assist you at the earliest possible.
